Query the Ensembl REST API

Source: R/analysis_information.R
queryEnsembl.Rd

Query the Ensembl REST API

Usage

queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character: API path

query

Character: API query

grch37

Boolean: query the Ensembl GRCh37 API? if FALSE, query the most recent API

Value

Parsed response or NULL if no response

Examples

path  <- "overlap/region/human/7:140424943-140624564"
query <- list(feature = "gene")
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
#>   assembly_name external_name seq_region_name version

#> 2        GRCh37            U6               7       1

#> 2               ncrna_homo_sapiens_37

#> 2                               U6 spliceosomal RNA [Source:RFAM;Acc:RF00026]
#>          biotype         gene_id strand canonical_transcript       end
#> 1 protein_coding ENSG00000157764     -1    ENST00000288602.6 140624564
#> 2          snRNA ENSG00000271932      1    ENST00000605989.1 140583978
#>                id         source feature_type     start
#> 1 ENSG00000157764 ensembl_havana         gene 140419127
#> 2 ENSG00000271932        ensembl         gene 140583872

path  <- "lookup/symbol/human/BRCA2"
query <- list(expand=1)
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
